nodes.summary: Under the hypotheses of `integral_payment_mul_density`, if moreover `0 ≤ Q ≤ 1` on `[a, b]` (a probability of sale) and the lowest type gets `U a ≥ 0`, the expected payment is at most `∫_a^b max(φ f, 0)` (Myerson 1981, Lemma 3 and §5 for one bidder and seller value `t₀ = 0`: selling exactly to the types with nonnegative virtual valuation maximizes the expected virtual surplus).

Then the expected payment is the expected virtual surplus minus the utility of the lowest type: `∫_a^b P f = ∫_a^b φ Q f - U a` (Myerson 1981, (4.10), for one bidder without revision effects).
